description: Single-file XML prompt orchestrator with forking, git annotations, tmux-backed Codex/Claude runs, and plain-editor controls.

userStories.title: Implement XML data model and canonical rewrite
userStories.description: As an operator, I want one XML file that stays canonical after each save so plain text edits are deterministic.
acceptanceCriteria: Conversation file is parsed as XML and rewritten in canonical formatting
Each human/assistant message is annotated with git head_short and dirty state
Write operations are atomic
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented in orchestrator.py with canonical_xml_text, annotate_git, and atomic_write.

userStories.title: Implement fork-on-middle-edit behavior
userStories.description: As an operator, I want editing a non-tip human message to preserve old history and create a new branch.
acceptanceCriteria: If a non-tip human message text changes, old text is restored on original branch
A new branch node is inserted with a new human message for edited content
Forked human message supports resume_from metadata
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented in apply_middle_edit_forks and covered by unit tests.

userStories.title: Implement backend command planning and output parsing
userStories.description: As an operator, I want Codex and Claude backend command support with final assistant message extraction.
acceptanceCriteria: Codex first-run and resume commands are generated from backend + session metadata
Claude first-run and resume commands are generated from backend + session metadata
Backend output parser extracts session id and final assistant message
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement tmux-backed watch loop runtime
userStories.description: As an operator, I want each prompt run to execute in disposable tmux sessions with log files and assistant writeback.
acceptanceCriteria: Watcher polls conversation file for saves and starts runs for pending human messages
Each run uses a dedicated tmux session and log file in .xml-orchestrator/logs
On completion, final assistant message is inserted under the triggering human message
tmux session is cleaned up after run completion
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Implement plain-editor cancellation and pending-save behavior
userStories.description: As an operator, I want to cancel a running prompt with killed=true and keep orchestration file writes owned by the orchestrator.
acceptanceCriteria: If running human message is saved with killed=true, orchestrator kills tmux run
Cancellation writes an assistant error node in conversation XML
During active run, orchestrator remains sole writer of XML file
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Create test suite for orchestrator core logic
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want tests for command building, output parsing, pending detection, and fork logic so changes stay safe.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests cover backend command generation
Unit tests cover codex output parsing
Unit tests cover pending human detection
Unit tests cover middle-edit fork behavior
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
